memory.title: Memory
memory.hint: Facts saved here are shared by all chats and characters. They are added to the system prompt of every chat that has memory switched on.
memory.autoHint: New facts are also extracted automatically from your messages.

memory.clearConfirm: Delete all {count} memories? This cannot be undone.
memory.archiveHint: Clean summaries of conversations you asked to remember. The most relevant ones are found automatically and added to new chats.
memory.archiveEmpty: No saved conversations yet. Say "remember this" in a chat or use the bookmark button at the top.
memory.modeKeyword: keyword only (set an embedding model for semantic search)
memory.archiveClearConfirm: Delete all {count} saved conversations? This cannot be undone.

panel.title: Settings

panel.keyEnvHint: Without a saved key, the environment variable {env} is used.

hints.extractModel: A cheap model with JSON support is enough; it runs once after every answer.
hints.summarizerModel: Runs only when you ask to remember a chat or press the bookmark button.
hints.embeddingModel: Without an embedding model, saved conversations are found by keyword search (BM25). Changing it re-embeds all entries in the background.
hints.minSimilarity: Cosine similarity, 0–1. Higher = fewer but closer matches.

panel.noEmbeddingModels: This provider lists no embedding models.
